values.value: s3(perf_s3, filename = 'parquet_s3_read_many/*.parquet', format = Parquet, structure = 'WatchID UInt64')

test.create_query: CREATE TABLE pq_s3_blob_10m (raw_blob String) ENGINE = S3(perf_s3, filename = 'parquet_s3_read/hits_10m.parquet', format = RawBLOB)
CREATE TABLE pq_s3_blob_{part} (raw_blob String) ENGINE = S3(perf_s3, filename = 'parquet_s3_read/athena/hits_{part}.parquet', format = RawBLOB)
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO pq_s3_blob_10m SELECT * FROM url('https://clickhouse-datasets.s3.amazonaws.com/hits/hits_10m_single_obfuscated.parquet', RawBLOB) SETTINGS s3_truncate_on_insert = 1

INSERT INTO pq_s3_blob_{part} SELECT * FROM url('https://clickhouse-public-datasets.s3.amazonaws.com/hits_compatible/athena_partitioned/hits_{part}.parquet', RawBLOB) SETTINGS s3_truncate_on_insert = 1

SELECT throwIf(arraySort(groupArray((_file, _size))) != [('hits_0.parquet', 122446530), ('hits_1.parquet', 174965044), ('hits_10m.parquet', 1144869403), ('hits_2.parquet', 230595491), ('hits_3.parquet', 192507052), ('hits_4.parquet', 140929275), ('hits_5.parquet', 122286439), ('hits_6.parquet', 122927935), ('hits_7.parquet', 123902333), ('hits_8.parquet', 122735269), ('hits_9.parquet', 133629314)]) FROM s3(perf_s3, filename = 'parquet_s3_read/**.parquet', format = One)
SELECT throwIf(sum(num_row_groups) != 17 OR sum(num_rows) != 10000000) FROM s3(perf_s3, filename = 'parquet_s3_read/hits_10m.parquet', format = ParquetMetadata)
SELECT throwIf(sum(num_row_groups) != 28 OR sum(num_rows) != 10000000) FROM s3(perf_s3, filename = 'parquet_s3_read/athena/hits_*.parquet', format = ParquetMetadata)

SELECT throwIf((count(), sum(cityHash64(*))) != (SELECT count(), sum(cityHash64(*)) FROM hits_10m_single)) FROM (SELECT * REPLACE (toDateTime(EventTime) AS EventTime, toDate(EventDate) AS EventDate, toDateTime(ClientEventTime) AS ClientEventTime, toDateTime(LocalEventTime) AS LocalEventTime) FROM s3(perf_s3, filename = 'parquet_s3_read/hits_10m.parquet', format = Parquet))
SELECT throwIf((count(), sum(cityHash64(tuple(*)))) != (10000000, 8843882336968295263)) FROM s3(perf_s3, filename = 'parquet_s3_read/athena/hits_*.parquet', format = Parquet)

SELECT throwIf(arraySort(groupArray((SearchPhrase, c))) != (SELECT arraySort(groupArray((SearchPhrase, c))) FROM (SELECT SearchPhrase, count() AS c FROM {src} WHERE SearchPhrase != '' GROUP BY SearchPhrase ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10) SETTINGS input_format_parquet_filter_push_down = 0, input_format_parquet_bloom_filter_push_down = 0, input_format_parquet_page_filter_push_down = 0, optimize_move_to_prewhere = 0, use_top_k_dynamic_filtering = 0, query_plan_optimize_lazy_materialization = 0)) FROM (SELECT SearchPhrase, count() AS c FROM {src} WHERE SearchPhrase != '' GROUP BY SearchPhrase ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10)

SELECT throwIf(count() != (SELECT count() FROM {src} WHERE URL LIKE '%google%' SETTINGS input_format_parquet_filter_push_down = 0, input_format_parquet_bloom_filter_push_down = 0, input_format_parquet_page_filter_push_down = 0, optimize_move_to_prewhere = 0, use_top_k_dynamic_filtering = 0, query_plan_optimize_lazy_materialization = 0)) FROM {src} WHERE URL LIKE '%google%'

SELECT throwIf((count(), sum(cityHash64(tuple(*)))) != (SELECT count(), sum(cityHash64(tuple(*))) FROM (SELECT * FROM {src} WHERE URL LIKE '%google%' ORDER BY EventTime LIMIT 10) SETTINGS input_format_parquet_filter_push_down = 0, input_format_parquet_bloom_filter_push_down = 0, input_format_parquet_page_filter_push_down = 0, optimize_move_to_prewhere = 0, use_top_k_dynamic_filtering = 0, query_plan_optimize_lazy_materialization = 0)) FROM (SELECT * FROM {src} WHERE URL LIKE '%google%' ORDER BY EventTime LIMIT 10)

INSERT INTO FUNCTION s3(perf_s3, filename = 'parquet_s3_read_many/{{_partition_id}}.parquet', format = Parquet) PARTITION BY cityHash64(WatchID) % 2000 SELECT * FROM s3(perf_s3, filename = 'parquet_s3_read/hits_10m.parquet', format = Parquet) WHERE intHash32(WatchID) % 50 = 0 SETTINGS s3_truncate_on_insert = 1, output_format_parquet_parallel_encoding = 0, max_insert_threads = 1
SELECT throwIf((count(), sum(num_row_groups), sum(num_rows)) != (2000, 2000, 200364)) FROM s3(perf_s3, filename = 'parquet_s3_read_many/*.parquet', format = ParquetMetadata)
SELECT throwIf(count() != 200364) FROM {many} SETTINGS use_parquet_metadata_cache = 0, remote_filesystem_read_prefetch = 0, log_comment = 'parquet_s3_read.many'
SELECT throwIf(count() != 200364) FROM {many} SETTINGS use_parquet_metadata_cache = 1, remote_filesystem_read_prefetch = 0, log_comment = 'parquet_s3_read.many'
SELECT throwIf(count() != 200364) FROM {many} SETTINGS use_parquet_metadata_cache = 1, remote_filesystem_read_prefetch = 0, log_comment = 'parquet_s3_read.many'

SELECT throwIf(groupArray((ProfileEvents['S3GetObject'], ProfileEvents['ParquetMetadataCacheHits'], ProfileEvents['ParquetMetadataCacheMisses'])) != [(2000, 0, 0), (2000, 0, 2000), (0, 2000, 0)]) FROM (SELECT ProfileEvents FROM system.query_log WHERE event_date >= yesterday() AND type = 'QueryFinish' AND log_comment = 'parquet_s3_read.many' AND query_start_time >= (SELECT max(_time) FROM s3(perf_s3, filename = 'parquet_s3_read_many/*.parquet', format = One)) ORDER BY event_time_microseconds)
test.query: SELECT count() FROM {many} SETTINGS use_parquet_metadata_cache = {cache}, remote_filesystem_read_prefetch = 0
SELECT SearchPhrase, count() AS c FROM {src} WHERE SearchPhrase != '' GROUP BY SearchPhrase ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10 FORMAT Null
SELECT count() FROM {src} WHERE URL LIKE '%google%'
SELECT * FROM {src} WHERE URL LIKE '%google%' ORDER BY EventTime LIMIT 10 FORMAT Null
test.drop_query: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS pq_s3_blob_10m, pq_s3_blob_0, pq_s3_blob_1, pq_s3_blob_2, pq_s3_blob_3, pq_s3_blob_4, pq_s3_blob_5, pq_s3_blob_6, pq_s3_blob_7, pq_s3_blob_8, pq_s3_blob_9 SYNC
